address: 51 place de la Mairie, Polliat, 01310, France
bio: The epitome of a family-run inn, where hearty portions of tasty cuisine du terroir are served with a smile in a freshly refurbished dining area. Calf's head, chicken in creamy sauce, chicken liver soufflé and frogs' legs are all on the menu. Well-kept guestrooms for overnight stays....
